verdict.rationale: Unleash's first-party docs say the Admin API gives full programmatic access to all resources, including flags, projects, environments, users and integrations. They also say this same API powers the Admin UI, which directly supports UI/API parity. The MCP server adds agent-facing access on top. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that every UI action, including enterprise features like change requests and release templates, is available via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
This API powers the Unleash Admin UI and enables automation workflows.
The Admin API provides comprehensive programmatic access to all Unleash resources.
